people.nameZh: 切斯瓦夫·姆沃特-菲亞烏科夫斯基

heading.zh-Hant: 1939年北部邊境特別部隊指揮官
heading.en: Commander of the northern frontier force (Narew Group), 1939

body.zh-Hant: 美國陸軍戰史把Mlot-Fijalkowski少將列為北部一支特別部隊的指揮官，部署於比布扎河與納雷夫河一帶，負責守衛格羅德諾—華沙鐵路線以北的波蘭邊界。該部隊被稱為納雷夫集群，與其他以「軍」稱呼的波軍指揮單位不同。
body.en: The US Army history names Maj. Gen. Mlot-Fijalkowski as commander of a special force in the north, disposed along the Biebrza and Narew rivers and tasked with holding the Polish frontier north of the Grodno–Warsaw rail line. That force is called the Narew Group, unlike the other Polish commands, which are usually called armies.

body.zh-Hant: 波蘭傳記辭典網站把他列為WP准將，生於1892年4月14日，卒於1944年4月17日。辭典標示他曾是波蘭軍團士兵、對布爾什維克戰爭參與者、1939年戰役參與者，並曾被關入納粹戰俘營。1939年3月4日，第18步兵師舉行他出任師長十週年的紀念活動，他接受比亞韋斯托克省長的祝賀。
body.en: The Polish biographical dictionary lists him as a brigadier general of the Polish Army, born 14 April 1892 and died 17 April 1944. It describes him as a Polish Legions soldier, a participant in the war with the Bolsheviks and in the September 1939 campaign, and a prisoner of a Nazi camp. On 4 March 1939 the 18th Infantry Division marked ten years of his command, and he received congratulations from the Białystok voivode.
